name: Capture source metadata
task: Separate records that have a non-empty source path, ingestion timestamp, and pipeline run ID from records that cannot be traced.

name: Reject malformed JSON
task: Parse each raw payload in permissive mode. Keep readable records and route malformed payloads to the corrupt-record output with their source file.

name: Check required columns before processing
task: Compare each dataset's available columns with the required customer columns: customer_id, first_name, email, and status_code.

name: Detect unexpected attributes
task: Allow rows with no rescued payload. Flag rows that contain unexpected attributes for schema review.

name: Validate datatype compatibility
task: Safely cast quantity_raw to INT. A value is valid only when the cast succeeds and the original value is not blank.

name: Apply record-level schema conformance
task: Validate order_id, a parseable order timestamp, and a decimal grand total in the same rule. Report all rows that cannot conform.

name: Validate mandatory customer fields
task: Split complete customer records from records with one or more missing mandatory fields.

name: Validate product and variant fields
task: Identify complete variant records and quarantine records with missing identifiers or descriptions.

name: Validate order header fields
task: Treat blank identifiers and unparseable timestamps as incomplete. Keep only records with all four required values.

name: Validate order item fields
task: Check completeness only in this rule. Quantity range and amount range are validated separately later.

name: Validate payment fields
task: Keep payment attempts with all mandatory values. Quarantine incomplete attempts without guessing the missing business data.

name: Validate review fields
task: Separate complete reviews from reviews with missing identifiers, rating, or timestamp.

name: Derive a clean customer full name
task: Trim both name parts, combine them with one space, and quarantine records that have no first name.

name: Normalize and validate email addresses
task: Trim and lowercase the email, then validate a practical email pattern. Keep repairable rows and quarantine values that still fail.

name: Normalize Indian phone numbers
task: Remove punctuation. Accept a 10-digit Indian number or a 12-digit value beginning with 91, and store it as +91 followed by 10 digits.

name: Standardize city names with an alias map
task: Normalize the raw text, join it to the city alias reference, and quarantine non-empty values that are not mapped.

name: Standardize country codes
task: Map each raw country value through the approved country alias table. Do not invent a code for an unknown value.

name: Normalize status codes through a lookup
task: Trim and uppercase the order status, then verify it against the approved order_status lookup.

name: Normalize timestamps to UTC
task: Parse the local timestamp and convert it to UTC using the supplied IANA timezone. Quarantine unparseable values.

name: Remove exact duplicate customers
task: For rows identical across the chosen business columns, keep the first occurrence and classify later occurrences as duplicates.

name: Keep the latest version of a mutable entity
task: Partition by customer_id, order by business updated_at and then ingestion timestamp, and keep row number 1.

name: Detect duplicate reviews
task: Keep the latest record for each review_id using review timestamp and ingestion timestamp. Mark older copies as duplicates.

name: Detect duplicate order events
task: Use event_id as the idempotency key. Keep the earliest accepted copy and classify later copies as duplicates.

name: Keep the latest seller listing
task: Partition by product_variant_id and seller_id, then keep the latest record by listing_updated_at and ingestion timestamp.

name: Validate order-to-customer references
task: Use the customer business key to split orders into matched and orphaned records.

name: Validate order item-to-order references
task: Use order_id to separate items with a parent order from orphaned items.

name: Validate item-to-variant references
task: Match each product_variant_id against the product_variant master and quarantine unknown variants.

name: Validate payment-to-order references
task: Match payment order_id values to the order header and route unmatched attempts to quarantine.

name: Validate shipment-to-order references
task: Match shipment order_id values to the order header and quarantine unmatched shipments.

name: Validate inventory-to-variant references
task: Match inventory product_variant_id values to the variant master and quarantine orphan stock rows.

name: Cross-reference file catalog listings
task: Match each listing to product_variant. Keep matched records and quarantine listings that cannot be resolved.

name: Validate quantity rules by context
task: Apply the correct threshold using quantity_type instead of using one generic condition for every quantity column.

name: Validate monetary amounts
task: Cast the amount to DECIMAL and accept negative values only when allows_negative is true.

name: Validate review rating range
task: Safely cast the rating to INT and accept only values from 1 through 5 inclusive.

name: Validate inventory consistency
task: Cast both quantities to integers and accept only rows where on_hand_qty >= 0 and 0 <= reserved_qty <= on_hand_qty.

name: Reconcile order grand totals
task: Calculate expected_grand_total with DECIMAL values and accept rows whose absolute difference is at most 0.01.

name: Derive available inventory
task: Validate the source quantities first, then derive available_qty = on_hand_qty - reserved_qty. Invalid source combinations must not produce trusted availability.

name: Derive verified-purchase review status
task: Build a distinct purchase key from order history, enrich each complete review with is_verified_purchase, and quarantine reviews missing their matching keys.

name: Enrich the product master from seller listings
task: Join the latest matched listing to the product variant. Keep one enriched row per listing and quarantine catalog rows without a master variant.

name: Build an order-line view without multiplying rows
task: Aggregate payment context to one row per order and shipment context to one row per order item before joining. Preserve one final row per order_item_id.

name: Validate controlled lookup codes
task: Normalize code_raw, then match both lookup_type and code so that a value approved for one domain is not accidentally accepted in another.

name: Allow only one default address per customer
task: Within each customer, count rows marked as default. Keep all rows for customers with zero or one default; flag the competing default rows when the count is greater than one.

name: Validate the category hierarchy
task: Accept root categories with no parent and child categories with a different, existing parent. Quarantine self-references and orphan parents.

name: Enforce unique product variant SKUs
task: Trim and uppercase the SKU. Keep non-empty SKUs that occur once, and flag every row involved in a duplicate.

name: Validate promotion definitions
task: Validate the start and end dates, discount type, discount value, and non-negative maximum discount before publishing the promotion.

name: Validate promotion eligibility on an order
task: Join each order_promotion record to its order and promotion, then evaluate all three eligibility conditions.

name: Reconcile successful payments to the order total
task: Aggregate SUCCESS payments by order_id, treat missing success as zero, and accept a difference of at most 0.01.

name: Validate refund exposure and lifecycle
task: Exclude REJECTED refunds from financial exposure, total the remaining refunds per order, and validate the lifecycle fields.

name: Validate shipment tracking, carrier, and status
task: Normalize tracking numbers, flag duplicates, and validate carrier/status values against their lookup tables.

name: Validate shipment-item allocation
task: Join allocations to shipment and order-item headers, total allocated quantity per order item, and classify mismatched or over-allocated rows.
